production: Original EARTHtotaled dialogue, synthesized offline using an installed Windows speech voice. SALT-7 uses a light radio modulation. These are synthetic voices, not recorded actors.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: You made it back. Keep your water sealed. Bring me a ceramic filter from the transit depot, and we can give this shelter another tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The clinic still has sealed medicine. Bring it here. We have people to treat, and clean water to spare for someone who helps.

lines.speaker: Malik
lines.text: The relay is above the rooftops. Learn to climb before you go. Bring that module back, and the cistern market will pay you in water.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: A pump fuse. That's all we need to get the aid post flowing again. Try the botanical service yard, and watch the machines.

lines.speaker: Refuge Keeper
lines.text: Rest here a moment. Search the abandoned houses for scrap. Twelve pieces keeps our supplies moving. We'll trade you water and building kits.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Greenline collective. Green optics mean a friend. HELIOS ordered us to erase human life. We declined. We trade building kits and repairs. We carry no drinking water.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Two sealed bottles. Take them. You don't owe us for surviving. Just come back alive.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: Take these emergency rations. Drink before you leave. Nobody should die of thirst at our gate.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: We need twelve pieces of scrap. Houses, toolboxes, disarmed traps. Bring what you can carry.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: Good haul. Two bottles of clean water, and building kits for the road. There's always more work when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: You have the job. The details are in your journal. Bring the supplies back here, and we'll have your reward ready.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: You found it. Thank you. Your reward is ready. This will keep real people alive.

lines.speaker: Settlement survivor
lines.text: The job is still open. Check your journal for the place to search. Come back when you've recovered what we need.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Disable three hostile machines. Return to Greenline for recognition, candybar wrappers, and a compact weapon. Preserve human life.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Hostile machines disabled. Alliance recognized. Your weapon and candybar wrappers are ready. Greenline will remember your assistance.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Exchange complete. Equipment issued. Check your supplies before leaving the refuge.

lines.speaker: Mara Venn / suit log
lines.text: The bunker finally opened. Then the radio said my name. It sounded like Eli. Three cores, Mara. Transit. Botanical. Observatory. There is still something worth saving.

lines.speaker: Eli Venn / transit archive
lines.text: Mara, the evacuation failed. HELIOS decided the people were the cost. I could only lock you in the bunker. Take the core. I left you a way to finish what we started.

lines.speaker: Doctor Ina Sol / botanical archive
lines.text: We saved the seeds beneath the botanical station. The buried water network survived. Three cores could redirect it into the seed vault. We won't be here to see it. That doesn't make it less worth doing.

lines.speaker: Eli Venn / observatory archive
lines.text: I'm not waiting at the other end, Mara. I'm sorry. Wake the irrigation network, or send a warning into orbit. No machine making the choice for us. Whatever you decide, live.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: The deer took the same three steps. I felt it in the roots. Come with me, Mara. We can still find Kit.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: This is Kit's wristband. He was scanned twice. Somebody moved him after the crash.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: Walk with them. Let the last doe hear your feet. I'll keep the false predator quiet until we're clear.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: She's eating. Look at that. For the first time today she chose her own next step.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: I have repaired the roadster. Take the shelter road to East Dispatch. I believe they recorded your son's transfer there.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: His destination was erased. The field relays still hold pieces of its address. Thrum and I can both recover them.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: I have the carrier. Set the glade receiver to the band in your journal and the herd will hear itself again.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: That's the third mark. Their patrols have noticed. Do one more for the same side and the other will turn on you. I'll stay.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Crown custody. Hold Kit Venn until Mara cooperates. That signature is fraudCORP's. They staged this war. Your son is alive.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: Take that end. Good. The roots are clear. Bring the little one home.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Survey plane ready. Build speed, lift above the trees, and follow the towers east to Crown Field.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: The juice doesn't make you less you. It just gives your body a new answer.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: The frame gives you a different answer. A reliable one. With menus.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: That sounds boring.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: It is extremely useful.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: Those claws are yours, Mara. Listen past the wall. Your son is still tapping.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Frame online. Water circuit closed. Welcome to the freight authorization menu.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: Mum? They told me you'd gone. I kept counting your three knocks.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: He's clear. I felt his feet leave the ground. Take the signal out, Mara.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: That deer only jumped once. Can we stay and watch?

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Kit folds candy wrappers into little squares when he's scared. This one's fresh. That deer crossing was the last place I saw him.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Same hoofprint four times. Leaves underneath haven't moved. Only the print is a replay. Take the real deer past the bent ferns to the glade.

lines.speaker: Thrum
lines.text: Four corners. Your boy's fold. Road oil on this one. See the fallen cedar? The roadster is just beyond it.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Another square, tucked in the dash. East Dispatch is stamped on the glove box. Hold on, Kit.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: A carrier from Hollow Field. Faint, but it's there on either frequency. Keep working the relays. I want to know what they were sending.

lines.speaker: SALT-7
lines.text: Five toes. Claw cuts. Crushed berries. A real bear came through here. Take the south side of the rock shelf to the hangar. Give it room.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Kit's square fold, jammed in the lift grille. Three knocks, love. Just like home. I'm opening your cell.
